picks.title: A 29MB AI model is the most useful thing I've run on my Raspberry Pi 5, and it doesn't need an AI HAT
picks.excerpt: The tiniest AI model I've tried on a Raspberry Pi 5 is only 29MB, and it's surprisingly handy
picks.rationale: A 29MB model running on a $60 board with no accelerator. A clear, copyable example of how small on-device AI can get.

picks.title: Learning to use local AI is exciting, overwhelming, and frustrating
picks.excerpt: If I gotta do it I want it on my terms.
picks.rationale: A first-person diary of running Hermes and Qwen models locally on a Mac Studio and a laptop. It shows the real friction of doing AI on your own device.

picks.title: Powerful new mini-PC launches with 128 GB RAM, dual 10 GbE and Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495
picks.excerpt: iBuyPower has launched a high-end mini-PC featuring 128 GB of RAM. Also equipped with AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 processor, the iBuyPower Pro AMD AI Halo Mini PC packs dual USB4, dual 10 GbE Ethernet and three M.2 slots into a housing that measures 200 x 198 x 70 mm.
picks.rationale: A newly launched 'AMD AI Halo' desktop box with 128GB of memory, the class of machine sold for running large models at home. It adds another vendor to the local-AI mini-PC field.

picks.title: Humanoid robot rental prices crater as dedicated exchanges appear
picks.excerpt: Unitree and other popular humanoid robot makers are renting their bipeds on dedicated exchanges now. The choreographed dance during the Chinese New Year has left a lasting impression with people who rent them.
picks.rationale: Unitree and other humanoid makers now rent robots through dedicated exchanges, and prices are falling fast. AI-driven robot hardware is becoming something you can book by the day.

picks.title: Siri AI beats Gemini at the thing that matters most
picks.rationale: A hands-on comparison of the two phone assistants now that Siri AI has shipped, from an Android-focused outlet. A useful read on where on-device assistants actually differ in daily use.
